translations.literal: Another edict ordered that the place where the tripods were cast be made the Baocheng Palace, seventy-one sections of buildings in all; a central hall called Spirit Power was set up to sacrifice to the Yellow Emperor;
translations.idiomatic: Another edict ordered that the place where the tripods were cast become the Baocheng Palace, with seventy-one sections of buildings; a central hall called Spirit Power was established to sacrifice to the Yellow Emperor;

sentences.zh: 東廡殿曰成功，祀夏後氏；

translations.literal: the eastern wing hall was called Achievement, sacrificing to the lord of Xia;
translations.idiomatic: the eastern wing hall, Achievement, sacrificed to the lord of Xia;

sentences.zh: 西廡殿曰持盈，祠周成王及周公、召公；

translations.literal: the western wing hall was called Holding Fullness, sacrificing to King Cheng of Zhou and the Duke of Zhou and the Duke of Shao;
translations.idiomatic: the western wing hall, Holding Fullness, sacrificed to King Cheng of Zhou, the Duke of Zhou, and the Duke of Shao;

sentences.zh: 後置堂曰昭應，祀唐李良及隱士嘉成侯魏漢津。

translations.literal: a rear hall was set up called Manifest Response, sacrificing to Li Liang of Tang and the recluse Marquis of Jiacheng Wei Hanjin.
translations.idiomatic: a rear hall, Manifest Response, sacrificed to Li Liang of Tang and the recluse Marquis of Jiacheng Wei Hanjin.

sentences.zh: 太常禮部言：「每歲欲于大樂告成崇政殿元進樂日，秋八月二十七日舉祀事，祀黃帝依感生帝、神州地祇為大祠，幣用黃，樂用宮架，祝文依祀聖祖稱嗣皇帝臣名。

translations.literal: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Ministry of Rites stated: "Each year it is desired that on the day when great music is completed and presented at the Chongzheng Hall, on the twenty-seventh day of the eighth month in autumn the sacrifice be performed; sacrifice to the Yellow Emperor follows the great sacrifice for the Birth-Responding Emperor and the Sacred Domain Earth Queen; silks are yellow; music uses the palace orchestra; the prayer text follows sacrifice to the Sagely Ancestor in calling the succeeding emperor your subject by name.
translations.idiomatic: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Ministry of Rites proposed that each year, on the twenty-seventh day of the eighth month—the day when the new court music was presented at the Chongzheng Hall—the sacrifice to the Yellow Emperor be performed as a great sacrifice on the model of the Birth-Responding Emperor and Sacred Domain Earth Queen, with yellow silks, palace orchestra music, and a prayer text following the Sagely Ancestor formula addressing the succeeding emperor as your subject by name.

sentences.zh: 其成功、持盈二殿，禮用中祀，幣各用白。

translations.literal: For the Achievement and Holding Fullness two halls, the rite uses middle sacrifice; silks for each are white.
translations.idiomatic: The Achievement and Holding Fullness halls would receive middle sacrifices, each with white silks.

sentences.zh: 昭應堂禮用小祀，並以素饌。」

translations.literal: The Manifest Response hall rite uses small sacrifice, all with plain food."
translations.idiomatic: The Manifest Response hall would receive a small sacrifice with plain food offerings."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 政和六年，用方士王仔昔議，定鼎閣于天章閣，自九成宮徙九鼎奉安之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Zhenghe, following the proposal of the master of methods Wang Zaixi, the Tripod Pavilion was fixed at the Tianzhang Pavilion; the nine tripods were moved from the Nine Accomplishments Palace and installed there.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Zhenghe, following Daoist master Wang Zaixi's proposal, the Tripod Pavilion was established at the Tianzhang Pavilion, and the nine tripods were moved from the Nine Accomplishments Palace and installed there.

sentences.zh: 又詔改帝鼐為隆鼐，正南彤鼎為明鼎，西南阜鼎為順鼎，正西皛鼎為蘊鼎，西北魁鼎為健鼎，正北寶鼎如舊，東北牡鼎為和鼎，正東蒼鼎為育鼎，東南岡鼎為潔鼎，鼎閣為圜象徽調之閣。

translations.literal: Another edict changed the Imperial Cauldron to Lofty Cauldron, the due-south Red Cauldron to Bright Cauldron, the southwest Mound Cauldron to Accord Cauldron, the due-west Bright Cauldron to Store Cauldron, the northwest Chief Cauldron to Robust Cauldron, the due-north Treasure Cauldron as before, the northeast Male Cauldron to Harmony Cauldron, the due-east Azure Cauldron to Nurture Cauldron, the southeast Ridge Cauldron to Purity Cauldron; the Tripod Pavilion was named the Pavilion of Circular Images and Fine Tuning.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict renamed the tripods: Imperial to Lofty, southern Red to Bright, southwest Mound to Accord, western Bright to Store, northwest Chief to Robust, northern Treasure unchanged, northeast Male to Harmony, eastern Azure to Nurture, southeast Ridge to Purity; and the Tripod Pavilion was named the Pavilion of Circular Images and Fine Tuning.

sentences.zh: 閣上神像，左周鼎星君，中帝席星君，右大角星君；

translations.literal: Above the pavilion were spirit images: on the left the Zhou Cauldron Star Lord, in the center the Imperial Seat Star Lord, on the right the Great Horn Star Lord;
translations.idiomatic: Spirit images were placed above the pavilion: the Zhou Cauldron Star Lord on the left, the Imperial Seat Star Lord in the center, and the Great Horn Star Lord on the right;

sentences.zh: 閣下鼎鼐神像，各守逐鼎布列，亦用仔昔議也。

translations.literal: below the pavilion were cauldron spirit images, each guarding its respective cauldron in array—this too followed Zaixi's proposal.
translations.idiomatic: below the pavilion stood cauldron spirit images, each guarding its respective tripod in array—also following Zaixi's proposal.

sentences.zh: 駕詣鼎閣奉安神像，明日復詣閣行香，百僚陪位。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage proceeded to the Tripod Pavilion to install the spirit images; the next day he again proceeded to the pavilion to offer incense, the hundred officials attending in place.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor proceeded to the Tripod Pavilion to install the spirit images; the next day he returned to offer incense, with officials in attendance.

sentences.zh: 其後，又詔九鼎新名乃狂人妄改，皆無依據，宜復舊名，惟圜象徽調閣仍舊。

translations.literal: Afterward another edict stated that the new names of the nine tripods were mad alterations without basis and should be restored to the old names; only the Pavilion of Circular Images and Fine Tuning remained as it was.
translations.idiomatic: Later another edict declared that the new tripod names were reckless alterations without basis and should be restored to their original names; only the Pavilion of Circular Images and Fine Tuning kept its new name.

sentences.zh: 八年，用方士言，鑄神霄九鼎成，曰太極飛雲洞劫之鼐、蒼壺祀天貯醇酒之鼎、山嶽五神之鼎、精明洞淵之鼎、天地陰陽之鼎、混沌之鼎、浮光洞天之鼎、靈光晃耀煉神之鼎、蒼龜火蛇蟲魚金輪之鼎，奉安於上清寶籙宮神霄殿，與魏漢津所鑄，凡十八鼎焉。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, following masters of methods, the Divine Empyrean nine tripods were cast and completed, named: Great Unity Flying Cloud Cavern Kalpa Cauldron, Azure Flask Sacrificing to Heaven Storing Pure Wine Cauldron, Mountains and Peaks Five Spirits Cauldron, Essence-Bright Cavern Abyss Cauldron, Heaven and Earth Yin and Yang Cauldron, Chaos Cauldron, Floating Light Cavern Heaven Cauldron, Spirit Light Gleaming Refining Spirit Cauldron, Azure Tortoise Fire Serpent Insects Fish Gold Wheel Cauldron—they were installed in the Divine Empyrean Hall of the Supreme Clarity Treasure Register Palace; together with those cast by Wei Hanjin, there were eighteen tripods in all.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, following Daoist masters' advice, the Divine Empyrean nine tripods were cast: Great Unity Flying Cloud Cavern Kalpa, Azure Flask Sacrificing to Heaven Storing Pure Wine, Mountains and Peaks Five Spirits, Essence-Bright Cavern Abyss, Heaven and Earth Yin and Yang, Chaos, Floating Light Cavern Heaven, Spirit Light Gleaming Refining Spirit, and Azure Tortoise Fire Serpent Insects Fish Gold Wheel. They were installed in the Divine Empyrean Hall of the Supreme Clarity Treasure Register Palace; together with Wei Hanjin's nine tripods, there were eighteen in all.
